senses.gloss: m. h. a. ch. (בקא) expert, versed, familiar.
units: <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 11:11">Targ. I Chr. XI, 11</cite>.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 10b:4">Kidd. 10ᵇ</cite> <he>ב׳ בחדרי תורה</he> well acquainted with the chambers (intricacies) of the Law; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:4:3">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>ב׳ בסתרי וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2">Snh. VII, 2</cite> <he>שלא היה ב״ד ב׳</he> the court was not versed in the law.
<cite ref="Yoma 49a">Yoma 49ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ ברפואות</he> an expert in medicine.

<cite ref="Yevamot 102a:8">Yeb. 102ᵃ</cite> <he>כלום אתה ב׳ בר׳ וכ׳</he> art thou acquainted with R. &c.?; <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 12:11">Tosef. ib. XII, 11</cite> <he>ב׳ היה לך בר׳ וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (read <he>ב׳ הי׳ לך ר׳</he> as oth. ed.) was R. … well known to thee? <cite ref="Ketubot 6b:11">Keth. 6ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="B01124"><he>בְּקִיאִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00133"><he>בְּקִיאֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 12:32">Targ. I Chr. XII, 32</cite> (Var. <cite ref="B01124"><he>בקיעין</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 4a:14">Ḥull. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>אין ב׳ וכ׳</he> (the Samaritans) are not so well versed in the details of the Law as &c.
Kidd. 30ᵃ אינהו ב׳ … אנן לא בְקִיאִינָן they (the ancients) were versed in Biblical orthography (in defective and plene), we are not.—Fem. בְּקִיאָה.

<cite ref="Chagigah 5a">Ḥag. 5ᵃ</cite>. [<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 49:12">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XLIX, 12</cite> <he>בַּקְיִין בהלכה</he> Ar., ed. <he>כה׳</he>, incorr., Levita in Tishbi <he>בְּקִיאין</he>; Y. I <he>נקיין מן חלבא</he>!]
